# WO-192: Guard developer landing-page hero art in built output
Status: delivered; owner review requested
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Amara Okoye
Source: read-only developer-page coverage scan by Amara Okoye

## Goal
Add an offline regression test for the light/dark hero art rendered on `/developers/`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add `tests/codex/test_cx_developer_hero_art.py` using the existing `web_dist` test pattern.
- Inspect only the built `web/dist/developers/index.html` and its two referenced asset files.
- Assert the dark-mode `<source>` points to `developers-dark.svg`, the fallback `<img>` points to `developers-light.svg`, both built files exist, the dimensions remain 640×480, and the built image alt is non-empty and matches the source page's declared alt text.
- Keep the test scoped to this hero art contract; no Open Graph metadata, marketing, unrelated page content, or broad site assertions.
- Build with `cd web && pnpm build` in the prepared worktree (use/remove the established borrowed `web/node_modules` link if needed), then run the focused pytest and Ruff commands below; record exact results in the worktree `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.
- If the built output disagrees with the page or art paths, do not edit source/art. Report the evidence and keep only the affected assertion as a strict xfail if required by the vendor test rule.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_developer_hero_art.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No changes to `web/src/`, art files, existing tests, `src/`, schema, project config, CI, dependencies, or other routes. No network, packages, user data, or real-world identity details.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_developer_hero_art.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_developer_hero_art.py`

## Check-in plan
Worktree `.vendor-wt/wo-192` on `vendor/wo-192`, based on latest owner-prepared local main. Confirm the worktree exists before editing. Report results in the worktree status and issue #164; Nora updates `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.
